nodes.description: Constant bytes32 role identifier keccak256('MINTER_ROLE') that gates privileged minting.
Constant bytes32 default admin role (0x00) used to gate administrative functions such as unpause.
Pausable state variable controlling whether token transfers/minting are halted.
AccessControl mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) storing role membership and admin roles.
ERC20 total token supply, mutated by _mint and _burn.
External initializer that sets name/symbol, mints initial supply to ownerAccount, grants admin/minter roles and pauses the contract.
External function restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE that unpauses the contract.
Pure function returning the contract version string '1.0'.
External function that checks msg.sender holds MINTER_ROLE and mints new tokens.
External function that reduces the caller's allowance and burns tokens from an account.
Caller-controlled address used for role checks and allowance authorization.
Internal _mint call inside initialize that creates the initial 100,000,000e18 supply.
Internal _mint call inside mint that creates tokens for an arbitrary recipient after a role check.
Internal _burn call inside burnFrom that destroys tokens from an account.
Internal _approve call inside burnFrom that writes the reduced allowance.
Address passed to initialize that receives the initial supply and roles.
Recipient address parameter of mint.
Amount parameter of mint.
Account parameter of burnFrom whose tokens are burned.
Amount parameter of burnFrom compared to and subtracted from the allowance.
Local variable in burnFrom holding allowance(account, _msgSender()) before subtraction.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed to hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, msg.sender) inside mint to authorize the caller.
MINTER_ROLE membership determines whether mint execution proceeds.
msg.sender is used as spender when reading allowance(account, _msgSender()) in burnFrom.
account parameter flows into the allowance lookup and burn target of burnFrom.
amount is compared with and subtracted from currentAllowance in burnFrom.
currentAllowance - amount is written through _approve inside burnFrom.
amount is forwarded to _burn reducing balances and totalSupply.
ownerAccount is the recipient of the initial _mint in initialize.
ownerAccount parameter is consumed by initialize for minting and role setup.
to parameter is the recipient of tokens created by _mint in mint.
amount_mint parameter is the quantity created by _mint in mint.
onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) gates the unpause function.
whenPaused modifier reads _paused before allowing unpause.
whenNotPaused modifier reads _paused and initialize calls _pause() at the end.
_mint inside mint increases _totalSupply and recipient balance.
_burn inside burnFrom decreases _totalSupply and account balance.
Initial _mint inside initialize increases _totalSupply by 100,000,000e18.
mint invokes the internal _mint operation after the role check.
burnFrom invokes _approve to write back the reduced allowance.
burnFrom invokes _burn to destroy account tokens.
initialize invokes the internal _mint for the initial supply.

normalization_plan.reason: ownerAccount is a constructor-style parameter whose only purpose is the initial mint and role setup performed by initialize.
to is the recipient parameter consumed exclusively by the mint function's _mint call.
amount_mint is the quantity parameter consumed exclusively by the mint function's _mint call.
account is the target parameter used only within burnFrom's allowance check and burn.
amount_burnFrom is the value parameter used only within burnFrom's allowance arithmetic and burn.
currentAllowance is a transient local computed and consumed entirely inside burnFrom.
